text:
Aisha Khan: FYI — PartnerWave HW go-live scheduled for next Tue. Need a last-mile check on SKU <-> entitlement mapping and minute-level usage sampling in staging. Who can own validation?
Marcus Lee: I can take the reconciliation checks. Quick Q: are partner pings minute or 30s granularity?
Lina Gomez: PartnerWave pings per-device every 60s in staging, but their staging clock can drift ~5-10s. They also send a heartbeat when device is idle with usage=0.
Raj Patel: Heads-up from finance: we need SKU-level revenue mapping for invoices, so entitlements must be deterministic for the billing window (UTC daily 00:00-23:59).
Tom Nguyen: I'll run the aggregation jobs. Suggest we run a 24h reconciliation comparing the partner's reported usage vs our ingest for a small customer cohort first.
Aisha Khan: Plan: (1) smoke test in staging for 10 devices, (2) run hourly reconciliation job for 6h, (3) validate entitlement assignment logic. Marcus/Lina/Tom: agree? :thumbsup:
Marcus Lee: Agree. I'll draft the reconciliation query. Basic idea: group by device_id, sku_id, bucket -> SUM(usage) and compare.
Marcus Lee: SQL draft:```sql
-- sandbox query, use staging schema
SELECT
  device_id,
  sku_id,
  DATE_TRUNC('minute', event_ts) as minute_bucket,
  SUM(usage_units) as sum_units
FROM staging.partnerwave_events
WHERE event_ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY device_id, sku_id, minute_bucket;
```
Lina Gomez: Partner sends events like:```json
{
  "device_id": "PW-1234",
  "sku": "edge-pro-v2",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-16T14:23:00Z",
  "usage_units": 1,
  "entitlement_id": "ent-789",
  "ping_type": "heartbeat"
}
```
Lina Gomez: Note: in staging they sometimes omit entitlement_id when device hasn't checked in for >10m. We need to map those to a default pending-entitlement state, not drop them.
Marcus Lee: Good catch. Reconciliation should mark events with null entitlement_id as "pending" and surface counts.
Tom Nguyen: I'll add a join to entitlement mapping table with left join and COALESCE(entitlement_id, 'PENDING-STAGING') for the comparison.
Raj Patel: Also confirm timezone normalization. Partner timestamps are UTC but device local logs might be local tz when they re-ingest — ensure ingestion pipeline forces UTC. Any drift detection?
Aisha Khan: Partner-onboard-bot: "staging-checklist created: /playbooks/partnerwave-staging-checklist (owner: lina)"
Lina Gomez: I'll run checksum validation too. Proposed heuristic: for each minute_bucket, if partner_reports != our_ingest by >10% for 5 consecutive minutes, flag for live hold and escalate to PartnerWave.
Marcus Lee: Add edge case: duplicate pings — they use client-retry with same event_id sometimes. We should dedupe on event_id first.
Tom Nguyen: Dedupe plan: use event_id as primary, fallback to (device_id, timestamp, sku) hash. I'll push a patch to the staging ingestion lambda:```bash
# staging deploy (dry-run)
./deploy.sh --env=staging --service=ingest --dry-run
```
Lina Gomez: I'll share sample payloads and a list of 10 device IDs to test. Expect them in #partnerships-ops channel.
Aisha Khan: Who owns the final gating criteria for go/no-go? We need to be explicit for Tue cutover.
Raj Patel: Finance criteria: SKU mapping complete + reconciliation delta <2% aggregated over test cohort and no outstanding pending-entitlement >5% of total usage.
Marcus Lee: Engineering criteria: <0.5% duplicated events after dedupe, timezone normalized, and no >10% minute-level spikes unexplained.
Lina Gomez: Ops criteria: onboarding runbook completed, alert thresholds configured in Console, and playbook links in the ticket.
Aisha Khan: Action items at 0900 PST tomorrow: Marcus — run reconciliation job and post results; Tom — deploy dedupe patch dry-run; Lina — provide test devices and payloads; Raj — verify billing mapping table. I'll consolidate decision and tag PartnerWave. :rocket:
partner-onboard-bot: "reminder set for 2026-03-17T17:00:00Z (0900 PST) — partnerwave-staging-check"
Tom Nguyen: Quick note — I'll include a sanity check query to detect large timezone shifts:```sql
SELECT device_id, MIN(event_ts) as first_ts, MAX(event_ts) as last_ts,
  DATE_DIFF('second', MIN(event_ts), MAX(event_ts)) as span_seconds
FROM staging.partnerwave_events
WHERE event_ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY device_id
HAVING span_seconds > 86400; -- > 1 day span indicates bad timezone/timewarp
```
Marcus Lee: Perfect. If we see timewarp we hold and ask partner to reconfigure NTP/clock.
Lina Gomez: I'll coordinate with PartnerWave SEs tonight to make sure NTP is enabled on test devices.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team. Post results in this thread. I'll open a quick internal ticket for go/no-go checklist.
Marcus Lee: Will do. Posting the first reconciliation CSV to the ticket after the job runs.
Raj Patel: If reconciliation looks clean, finance will prepare the initial invoice mapping and confirm entitlements.
Aisha Khan: Closing loop — meet back here after 0900 PST check. :eyes:
